description_zh: 创建一个E-HPC Instant 作业
name: CreateJob

parameters.help_en: The job name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 作业名称。长度为 2~64 个字符，支持英文、中文和数字。可以包含短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: job_name

fields.help_en: The end value of the array job index. Valid values: 0 to 4999. The value must be greater than or equal to IndexStart
fields.help_zh: 数组作业索引的结束值。取值范围：0~4999，且大于等于IndexStart
fields.name: index_end

fields.help_en: The start value of the array job index. Valid values: 0 to 4999
fields.help_zh: 数组作业索引的起始值。取值范围：0~4999
fields.name: index_start

fields.help_en:
The step size of the array job index.
If the array job properties are IndexStart=1, IndexEnd=5, and IndexStep=2, the array job contains three child jobs with index values of 1, 3, and 5. Your application can access these values through environment variables
fields.help_zh:
数组作业索引的间隔。
若数组作业属性为IndexStart=1,IndexEnd=5,IndexStep=2，则该数组作业包含三个子作业，子作业索引值分别为1,3,5，用户业务程序可以通过环境变量方式访问
fields.name: index_step

fields.help_en:
The details of the array job. The sub-job index values are passed to the runtime environment through environment variables, which can be referenced by user applications. The environment variables include:
EHPC_JOB_NAME: The job name, corresponding to the JobName parameter.
EHPC_JOB_ID: The job ID.
EHPC_TASK_NAME: The task name, corresponding to the TaskName parameter.
EHPC_EXECUTOR_ID: The executor ID.
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID: The sub-job index value.
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT: The total number of sub-jobs.
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_MAX: The maximum sub-job index value, corresponding to the IndexStart parameter.
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_MIN: The minimum sub-job index value, corresponding to the IndexEnd parameter.
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_STEP: The sub-job index step, corresponding to the IndexStep parameter
fields.help_zh:
数组作业详情。子作业索引值通过环境变量传递到运行环境中，支持用户业务程序引用。环境变量包括：
EHPC_JOB_NAME：作业名称，对应参数JobName。
EHPC_JOB_ID：作业ID。
EHPC_TASK_NAME：任务名称，对应参数TaskName。
EHPC_EXECUTOR_ID：执行单元ID。
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID：子作业索引值。
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_COUNT：子作业总数量。
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_MAX：子作业索引最大值，对应参数IndexStart。
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_MIN：子作业索引最小值，对应参数IndexEnd。
EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_STEP：子作业索引步长，对应参数IndexStep
fields.name: array_spec

fields.help_en: The maximum number of nodes for the job
fields.help_zh:
作业运行最大节点数。
需遵循计算公式：`MaxCount = (IndexEnd - IndexStart) / IndexStep + 1`
fields.name: max_count

fields.help_en: The task execution policy
fields.help_zh: 任务执行策略
fields.name: executor_policy

fields.help_en: The task name. The name must be 2 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh: 任务名称。长度为 2~32个字符，支持英文、中文和数字。可以包含短划线（-）和下划线（_）
fields.name: task_name

fields.help_en: The number of CPUs in the runtime environment
fields.help_zh: 运行环境的CPU个数
fields.name: cores

fields.help_en: The cloud disk size. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 云盘大小。单位为GiB
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The cloud disk type. Currently, only System is supported, which indicates a system cloud disk
fields.help_zh: 云盘类型。目前仅支持System，表示系统盘
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The cloud disk array
fields.help_zh: 云盘数组
fields.name: disks

fields.help_en: Specifies whether hyper-threading is enabled in the runtime environment. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 运行环境是否开启超线程。默认值：true
fields.name: enable_ht

fields.help_en: The hostname prefix of the runtime environment. The following limits apply:
fields.help_zh:
运行环境主机名前缀。限制说明如下：

半角句号（.）和短划线（-）不能作为首尾字符，更不能连续使用。
Windows环境：字符长度不超过10，不支持半角句号（.），不能全是数字。允许包含大小写英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
Linux环境：字符长度不超过32，支持多个半角句号（.），点之间为一段，每段允许包含大小写英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
fields.name: host_name_prefix

fields.help_en: The instance types of the runtime environment. A maximum of 5 instance types are supported
fields.help_zh: 运行环境的实例规格。最多5组
fields.name: instance_types

fields.help_en: The memory size of the runtime environment. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 运行环境的内存大小。单位为GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The runtime environment resource information
fields.help_zh: 运行环境资源信息
fields.name: resource

fields.help_en: The next action for the task
fields.help_zh:
任务下一步行为。

Retry：当命中特定退出码时，作业开始新一轮重试。

Exit：当命中特定退出码时，作业退出
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The task exit code, which is used together with Action to form a job retry rule. Valid values: 0 to 255
fields.help_zh: 任务退出码，配合 Action 组成作业重试规则。取值范围：0～255
fields.name: exit_code

fields.help_en: The retry rules. A maximum of 10 rules are supported
fields.help_zh: 重试规则。最多10组
fields.name: exit_code_actions

fields.help_en: The number of retries. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 重试次数。取值范围：1～10。默认值：3
fields.name: retry_count

fields.help_en: The task retry policy
fields.help_zh: 任务重试策略
fields.name: retry_policy

fields.help_en: The container application ID
fields.help_zh: 容器应用ID
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container startup command. A maximum of 10 arguments are supported
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多 10 组
fields.name: arg

fields.help_en: The list of container startup commands. A maximum of 20 commands are supported, and each command can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
容器启动命令列表。最多20个命令，单个命令最长256个字符。    
若启动命令包含空格（例如：`sleep 60s`），传入的JSON格式参数为`["sleep", "60s"]`。
若启动命令较复杂，参数格式可以采用`Command: ["/bin/bash"]`和`Arg:["-c", "<customized command>"]`组合的方式。其中`<customized command>`为用户自定义的命令组合，可包含空格等字符
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The environment variable name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The format is [0-9a-zA-Z] and underscores. The name cannot start with a digit
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为 1~128 位。格式要求：[0-9a-zA-Z]，以及下划线，不能以数字开头
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The environment variable value. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值。长度为 0~256 位
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The environment variables of the container. A maximum of 20 environment variables are supported
fields.help_zh: 容器的环境变量。最多20组
fields.name: environment_vars

fields.help_en: The container image
fields.help_zh: 容器镜像
fields.name: image

fields.help_en:
The list of mount parameters for a self-managed image registry. The parameters are in key-value format and passed as JSON.

Reference format: {"ImageRegistryType":"https","ImageRegistryServer":"xxx","ImageRegistryUserName":"xxx","ImageRegistryPassword":"xxx"}
fields.help_zh:
自建镜像仓库挂载参数列表。为 KV 形式，采用 JSON 传递。

参考格式：{"ImageRegistryType":"https","ImageRegistryServer":"xxx","ImageRegistryUserName":"xxx","ImageRegistryPassword":"xxx"}
fields.name: image_registry_options

fields.help_en: The container working directory
fields.help_zh: 容器工作目录
fields.name: working_dir

fields.help_en: The container environment settings
fields.help_zh: 使用容器环境
fields.name: container

fields.help_en: The virtual machine application ID
fields.help_zh: 虚拟机应用ID
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: 环境变量名
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: 环境变量值
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: 虚拟机的环境变量
fields.help_zh: 虚拟机的环境变量
fields.name: environment_vars

fields.help_en: The image ID
fields.help_zh: 镜像ID
fields.name: image

fields.help_en:
The logon password for the virtual machine environment. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/

For Windows environments, the password cannot start with a forward slash (/).

If you specify the Password parameter, use HTTPS to send the request to avoid password leaks
fields.help_zh:
虚拟机环境登录密码。长度为 8 至 30 个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：

()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
其中，Windows环境不能以正斜线（/）为密码首字符。

如果传入Password参数，建议您使用 HTTPS 协议发送请求，避免密码泄露
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The pre-processing script. The script must be Base64-encoded
fields.help_zh: 前处理脚本。需Base64编码
fields.name: prolog_script

fields.help_en: The job execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded
fields.help_zh: 运行作业脚本。需Base64编码
fields.name: script

fields.help_en: The virtual machine environment settings
fields.help_zh: 使用虚拟机环境
fields.name: vm

fields.help_en: The task execution configuration
fields.help_zh: 任务执行配置
fields.name: task_executor
mount_options

fields.help_en: The directory where the data volume is mounted to the task
fields.help_zh:
任务挂载数据卷的目录。

挂载目录下的内容会被Volume的内容直接覆盖，请谨慎使用
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the data volume is read-only. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 数据卷是否只读。默认值：false
fields.name: read_only

fields.help_en:
The supported volume type. Valid values:
alicloud/nas: mounts a NAS file system.
alicloud/oss: mounts an OSS bucket
fields.help_zh:
当前支持的数据卷类型。
alicloud/nas: 挂载 NAS。
alicloud/oss: 挂载OSS
fields.name: volume_driver

fields.help_en: The list of data volumes mounted to the task. A maximum of 10 volumes are supported
fields.help_zh: 任务挂载的数据卷列表。最多10组
fields.name: volume_mount

fields.help_en: The task specification details
fields.help_zh: 任务规格详情
fields.name: task_spec

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the job is long-running. Valid values:

true: The job is a backend service job.
false: The job is a batch job.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否是长时间运行的作业。
true： 后台服务作业。
false： 批处理作业。

默认值：false
fields.name: task_sustainable

parameters.help_en: The task list. Currently, only one task is supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务列表，当前仅支持1个任务
parameters.name: tasks

fields.help_en: The resource type
fields.help_zh:
资源类型。
Standard：标准型。
Dedicated：专属型，需开通白名单使用。
Economic：经济型，需开通白名单使用
fields.name: allocation_spec

fields.help_en:
The computing power level. This parameter takes effect only when the resource type is economy. Valid values:

General: general-purpose.
Performance: compute-optimized instance.

Default value: General
fields.help_zh:
算力等级，仅在资源类型为经济型时有效。支持以下类型：
General：通用型。
Performance：性能型。

默认值：General
fields.name: level

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to create a public IP address for the job
fields.help_zh:
作业是否创建公网IP。
true：创建公网IP。
false： 不创建公网IP。

默认值：false
fields.name: enable_external_ip_address

fields.help_en: The vSwitch array
fields.help_zh: 交换机数组
fields.name: vswitch

fields.help_en: The network configuration
fields.help_zh: 网络配置信息
fields.name: network

fields.help_en: The job resource pool
fields.help_zh: 作业资源池
fields.name: pool

fields.help_en: The job priority. A larger value indicates a higher scheduling priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 作业优先级。取值越大，作业调度优先级越高。取值范围：1～100
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The tag key of the job. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 作业标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the job. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 作业标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The job tag information. A maximum of 20 tags are supported
fields.help_zh: 作业标签信息。最多20组
fields.name: tag

parameters.help_zh:
作业调度器类型。
HPC
K8S

默认值：HPC
parameters.name: job_scheduler

fields.help_en: The security group ID array
fields.help_zh: 安全组ID数组
fields.name: security_group_ids

fields.help_en: The security group
fields.help_zh: 安全组
fields.name: security_group

fields.help_en: The job ID
fields.help_zh: 作业ID
fields.name: job_id

fields.help_en: The dependency type. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
依赖类型。取值范围：

AfterSucceeded：所依赖作业或数组作业所有子任务运行成功（退出码为0）。
AfterFailed：所依赖作业或数组作业任一子任务运行失败（退出码非0）。
AfterAny：所依赖作业运行结束（成功或失败）。
AfterCorresponding：所依赖数组作业对应的子任务运行成功（退出码为0）。

默认值：AfterSucceeded
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The job dependencies. A maximum of 10 groups are supported
fields.help_zh: 作业依赖。最多10组
fields.name: job_dependency

ExecutorIds.description_en: The list of executor IDs contained in the task

items.description_en: The executor ID. The format is JobId-TaskName-ArrayIndex
